findings: Normal ECG or early right ventricular change
Normal axis with normal P waves

echoTasks.find: Low velocity tricuspid jet with normal right heart size in the focused right view
Normal septal motion without flattening in the papillary short axis
Inferior vena cava collapsing well on sniff

auscultation.murmur: Soft ejection murmur from high flow, grade 1 of 6

exam.general: 44 year old woman with scleroderma skin changes, no distress, mild finger pallor
exam.other: Skin thickening over fingers, no oedema, lungs clear with fine basal crackles

history.a: Tight skin over fingers for 3 years, mild breathlessness on hurrying, no syncope
No chest pain, no leg swelling, no wheeze
Scleroderma diagnosed 3 years ago, on penicillamine irregularly
No smoking, no biomass exposure now, cooks on gas
Homemaker, anxious about lung and heart involvement
No family lung or heart disease

keyPoints: Record the full screening dataset with velocity, atrial size, septal shape and caval collapse in protocol order
Repeat screening yearly or sooner if breathlessness worsens, per the pulmonary hypertension screening guidance
Optimise scleroderma care with rheumatology and interstitial lung review in parallel
Counsel that low probability today still needs periodic review, with red flags explained
Keep Doppler alignment and scale identical so trends reflect physiology, not technique
management.model: Protocolised yearly screening with identical Doppler technique and parallel rheumatology care

stem: A 44 year old woman from Chennai with scleroderma attends yearly heart and lung screening with only mild breathlessness on hurrying. Examination is unremarkable and the ECG is normal.
teaching: Low means velocity 2.8 m per s or below with pressure below 36 mmHg
Screening is the sonographer home ground: velocity, chambers, septum, cava, in order
Identical alignment and scale make year to year trends trustworthy
Low probability still earns yearly review with red flags clearly explained
title: Low probability pulmonary hypertension on scleroderma screening
